title_sq: Apartamenti 1+1 ne Shitje tek Komuna e Parisit
description_sq:
Komuna e Parisit, Komleksi White Tower, disponojme per shitje apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 79.2m2, kati e 12 ne ndertim te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet nga soxhorno, korridori shperndares, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Apartamenti ndodhet ne faze pllakash.
Shitet 202 000 Euro!
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in the Municipality of Paris
description_en: Municipality of Paris, White Tower Complex, we have for sale a 1+1 apartment with an area of ​​79.2m2, 12th floor in a new building with an elevator. The apartment is organized by living room, distribution corridor, bedroom, toilet and balcony. The apartment is located in the tile phase. For sale 202 000 Euro!
